name: 🥒 Cottage Cheese & Cucumbers
what: Cottage cheese with cucumbers and tomatoes, like a mini Greek salad.
extras: cherry tomatoes, olive oil, everything seasoning, dill

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Slice cucumbers into coins, halve the tomatoes.
Cottage cheese into 4 bowls, veggies on top.
Drizzle of olive oil, salt, pepper and everything seasoning.

key: A drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt make it taste fancy.
plan_b: Out of cottage cheese? Veggies with ranch.
